title: 7 August 1963: Live: Springfield Ballroom, Jersey
content:
The second of four concerts by The Beatles on Jersey in the Channel Islands, booked by local promoter Les De La Mare, took place on 7 August 1963.

Before the show The Beatles explored the beach, and Ringo Starr was filmed climbing over rocks.
